name: Property list
description: A record's attributes as a definition list: a muted term (an icon and a label) and its value, side by side, wrapping under each other when the value doesn't fit.

classes.ayy-property-list: Root <dl>. Rows stack with no gap; the rows own the padding.
classes.ayy-property-list--sm: Small: the compact rows (6px block padding, a 7rem term basis) with text a pixel smaller.
classes.ayy-property-list--lg: Large: 16px block padding, text a pixel larger, a 9rem term basis and 20px icons.
classes.ayy-property-list--compact: Tight rows: 6px block padding instead of 12px and a 7rem term basis instead of 8rem.
classes.ayy-property-list__row: The <div> that holds one <dt> and one <dd>: a wrapping flex row with the term at an 8rem basis and the value taking the rest.
classes.ayy-property-list__term: The <dt>: a decorative icon and the label, at an 8rem basis and in --ayy-color-muted. The term never grows; the value takes the remaining width.
classes.ayy-property-list__label: The label inside the term. Wraps inside the term's column.
classes.ayy-property-list__icon: An optional Icon before the label: 16px, muted, never shrinks. Decorative, so the label names the row.
classes.ayy-property-list__value: The <dd>: the value in --ayy-color-text. Long words wrap inside it (overflow-wrap: anywhere) instead of overflowing.
classes.ayy-property-list__empty: What an empty value reads ("Not set"): muted, in place of the value.

default.looks: Muted, icon-led terms in an 8rem column and text-coloured values beside them, each row with 12px block padding and no hairline.

hover.none: Rows aren't interactive; a nested InlineEdit keeps its own hover.

pressed.none: Rows aren't interactive; their nested controls keep their own pressed look.

focus.none: Rows aren't focusable; their nested controls keep their focus rings.

disabled.none: The list doesn't disable; disable the control in a value, or drop the row.

selected.none: Not a choice control; use List or a Table with selected rows.

error.none: No error look; a value that failed validation nests a FieldError or an InlineEdit with aria-invalid on its field.

loading.none: No loading look; show Skeleton rows with aria-busy on the list.

empty.looks: The __empty span takes --ayy-color-muted instead of a blank value; forced colours draw it as GrayText.

scale.sm: 6px block padding, a 7rem term, --ayy-text-s minus 1px text (12px compact, 13 touch).
scale.md: 12px block padding, an 8rem term, --ayy-text-s text (13px compact, 14 touch).
scale.lg: 16px block padding, a 9rem term, --ayy-text-s plus 1px text (14px compact, 15 touch), 20px icons.

sizes.density: Row text follows data-density through --ayy-text-s (13px compact and comfortable, 14px touch). compact swaps the 12px block padding for 6px.
sizes.width: Fills its container. The term takes an 8rem basis (7rem compact) and the value 10rem; when they don't fit together the value wraps under its term. Long unbroken values wrap inside the value.

js: propertyListClass({ size?, compact?, className? }) → string; propertyListRowClass, propertyListTermClass, propertyListLabelClass, propertyListIconClass, propertyListValueClass, propertyListEmptyClass constants.

props.size: "sm" | "md" | "lg" — row padding, text and term column
props.compact: boolean — tight rows with a shorter term column, for a dense summary.

props.label: ReactNode (required) — the term's text.
props.icon: ReactNode — an Icon before the label (give it className="ayy-property-list__icon").
props.empty: boolean — there is no value: show emptyText muted instead of children.
props.emptyText: ReactNode — what an empty value reads. Default "Not set".

a11y: It's a real <dl>: screen readers announce a definition list and pair each term with its value.
Each row is a <div> inside the <dl> (valid HTML) with exactly one <dt> and one <dd>, so the rows can wrap and flex.
Icons in the term are decorative; the label names the row.
An empty value says "Not set" in text, not a dash or a blank cell.
A value edited in place keeps the nested InlineEdit's own label ("Change the version"); the term names the attribute, the control names the action.
do: Use a property list for a record's attributes: a project, a server, an order, a person.
Keep terms short and values plain; nest a control only for a value edited in place.
Use PropertyRow empty and emptyText when there is no value, so the row stays and reads as empty.
Use compact inside a card header or a dense summary.
dont: Don't use it for rows that open something or carry actions at the end — use List.
Don't use it for preferences with a control per row — use Settings.
Don't use it for values people compare across columns — use Table.
Don't hand-build the rows: the <dt>/<dd> pairing is what screen readers announce.
